detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Tiny Mac tip: text that refuses to be copied. A video frame, a screenshot, a PDF someone locked.

In Pocketry I press Ctrl+Option+T, drag a box over it, and the words land on my clipboard. Apple's on-device recognition does the reading, and the picture is deleted straight away.

I use it more than I expected to.

#MacApps #Productivity
